title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Annotated declarations indexed, companion objects in the Outline
summary: A class, property or enum entry with an annotation on the same line was not indexed at all: no Outline entry, no Go to Definition, no usages. An unnamed companion object now appears in the Outline with its members under it. The index snapshot is rebuilt once after the update.

highlights.title: Annotated declarations are back
highlights.description: `@AndroidEntryPoint class`, `@Entity(...) data class`, `@Inject lateinit var`, `@field:SerializedName("a") val` in a constructor and `@SerializedName("ACTIVE") ACTIVE` were skipped by the parser. They are indexed again, with the column on the name and not on its copy inside the annotation string.

highlights.title: Companion objects in the Outline
highlights.description: An unnamed `companion object` shows as `Companion` with its constants and factories nested under it, instead of hanging under the previous function. Member names still resolve as `Foo.TAG`.

highlights.title: Brace count survives mid-line comments
highlights.description: `class A { /* { */ }` no longer shifts every following declaration one level deeper, and a `/*` left open at the end of a line now hides the commented-out code from the index.

sections.heading: Parser
bullets: Indexes declarations whose annotation sits on the same line, plus `value class` and the `final` modifier.
Shows an unnamed `companion object` in the Outline; no usage lens and no workspace search hit for the synthetic name.
Indexes annotated enum entries and extension properties (`val List<Int>.sum3` was recorded as `List`).
A `;` line in an enum no longer turns the next uppercase continuation line into a phantom entry.
A `val` inside a lambda passed as a named argument is no longer a primary-constructor property.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Outline: an enum class following another enum got the EnumMember icon; `class Foo @Inject constructor(private val x: Int)` was shown as a private class.
The `hoverEnabled`, `foldingEnabled` and `signatureHelp` settings apply without a window reload.
No "role?" accessibility hint on a `clickable` whose `role =` argument sits on a following line.
The cron tooltip rejects a reversed day-of-week range (`5-1`).
